because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

parallels.note: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of…

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

people.name: Meribah
people.line: A place where Moses disobeyed God

people.name: Zin
people.line: A desert and wilderness region south of Judah

translations.web: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
translations.bsb: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters.” Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
translations.kjv: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
translations.asv: because ye rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes. (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
